title_zh: 约定提供文件丢失问题的截图

scenario.label_zh: 约定提供文件丢失问题的截图
scenario.goal_zh: 澄清文件并未被用户主动删除，并约定提供截图与出错时间供客服排查

context_zh: 用户向应用客服描述文件从列表中消失的问题，客服尚未找到原因。
author: author-phase11-a

sentences.speaker: Kira
sentences.text: This is so frustrating. My file disappeared just as I finished editing it.

sentences.speaker: Max
sentences.text: I understand the frustration. Did you delete it, or did it vanish from the list on its own?

sentences.speaker: Kira
sentences.text: It vanished. I feel like an idiot for not saving a separate copy.

sentences.speaker: Max
sentences.text: You are not an idiot. Let's establish what happened before blaming anyone. Do you have a screenshot handy?

sentences.speaker: Kira
sentences.text: Yes, one of the empty file list. I can send it with the time the problem started.

sentences.speaker: Max
sentences.text: Please do. I will check those details against the error records before suggesting a recovery step.

sentences.speaker: Kira
sentences.text: I'll send both now. I won't change anything else in the app while you check.
